d:
Some dogs arrive at Villalobos with painful injuries, others are struggling with illness, fear or the effects of being abandoned. Each case brings a different challenge for Tia Torres and her team, from providing urgent care to helping dogs regain their confidence. But the biggest test often comes when these dogs meet people who could change the course of their lives.
Watch as the team takes on emotional rescue missions, works through difficult recoveries and introduces these pit bulls to potential adopters. Will the dogs who have endured so much finally find a family ready to welcome them?
